biotools.summary: Joins biological CSV and TSV tables using relational join semantics with optional identifier normalization for life-science keys such as Ensembl gene IDs, UniProt accessions, and sample barcodes. The browser workspace runs the same join engine as the PyPI-distributed Python client and CLI, which call the Pepkio Tools API for scripted pipelines. Calculator logic executes on Pepkio servers; the client transmits table text and join options and returns merged tables with match statistics and shareable run identifiers.

credit.name: Pepkio
credit.note: Pepkio develops software tools and bioinformatics solutions for life science researchers, including laboratory calculators and analysis services.

function.note: Relational joins for biological tables with optional identifier normalization and duplicate-key reporting.
